song.title: Everybody Else Less
song.description: A fictional narrator feels like shit and takes it out on everybody else. A song about self-dislike, social-media spite, and the hurt underneath it.

lyrics.text:
[Verse 1]
Everybody’s bleeding from a pocket guillotine
Everybody’s tethered to a glowing little screen
Scrollin’ through the comments, every word’s a guillotine
I laughed it off in public, then I sunk between

Opened up the timeline, felt it bite at my knees
Every joke is armor over rotting self-belief
I don’t like the mirror but I like you even lesser
If I’m the broken record, you’re the scratched-up, skipping lecture

[Pre-Chorus]
I’m not mad we got feelings
Spinnin’ round in a spiral
I’m mad I hate what I’m seein’
But I hate you more than my reflection tonight

[Chorus]
Everybody’s got a wound
Everybody’s got a lie
Everybody’s got a story
But I’m sick of yours and mine

Everybody shuts their eyes
Everybody hides their sneers
You don’t like me? I don’t like me
But I like you even less, my dear

[Verse 2]
Tiny storms in small towns
Throwin’ shade down Main Street
All sweet and sugar-coated
While they root for you to bleed

Everybody shuts their eyes
Everybody crowns their fears
But there’s a petty little joy
When I mute your plastic cheer

[Bridge]
Everybody’s bleeding from a pocket guillotine
Everybody’s tethered to a glowing little screen
Opened up the timeline, felt it bite at my knees
Every snarky little comment is a choir off the key

I’m not mad we got feelings
I’m mad they circle like flies
If I’m a mess in the making
You’re the stain I won’t disguise

[Chorus]
Everybody’s got a wound
Everybody’s got a lie
Everybody’s got a story
But I’m sick of yours and mine

Everybody shuts their eyes
Everybody hides their sneers
You don’t like me? I don’t like me
But I like you even less, my dear
Everybody shuts their eyes
Everybody crowns their fears
You don’t like me? I don’t like me
But I like you even less this year
